question:
The graph shows the production of wheat (in lakh tons) by states M, N, and O in four consecutive years. Find the year which has the minimum production of wheat. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b29dddfb5beaf55c09bad2356a5b2c50fbae76fe98f3ebfefccabec25c9825c.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of wheat in 2017 by M, N and O = 256 + 534 + 576 = 1366

Production of wheat in 2018 by M, N and O = 312 + 480 + 190 = 982

Production of wheat in 2019 by M, N and O = 290 + 310 + 335 = 935

Production of wheat in 2020 by M, N and O = 385 + 550 + 620 = 1555

Minimum production of wheat in the year 2019.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
